parameters.name: AudioJson
parameters.description_zh: 输出音频的音色与格式，仅适用于 Qwen-Omni 模型，且modalities参数需为["text","audio"]。
parameters.description_en: Output audio voice and format; only applicable to the Qwen-Omni model, provided that the modalities parameter is set to ["text", "audio"].

parameters.name: DesensitizationRule
parameters.description_zh: 脱敏类别，needDesensitization为true时不可为空
parameters.description_en: Masking category. Required when needDataMasking is true.

parameters.name: EnableCodeInterpreter
parameters.description_zh: 是否开启代码解释器功能。仅当model为qwen3-max-preview且enable_thinking为true时生效。
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the code interpreter feature. Takes effect only when model is qwen3-max-preview and enable_thinking is true.

parameters.name: EnableSearch
parameters.description_zh: 是否开启联网搜索。
parameters.description_en: Whether to enable web search.

parameters.name: EnableThinking
parameters.description_zh: 使用混合思考模型时，是否开启思考模式。
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to enable Thinking Mode when using hybrid thinking models.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID，通过实例ID指定对应的脱敏规则。可通过调用接口[ListInstances](~~141936~~)或[GetInstance](~~141567~~)获取该参数的值。
parameters.description_en: The ID of the instance, used to specify the corresponding data masking rules. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.

parameters.name: Logprobs
parameters.description_zh: 是否返回输出 Token 的对数概率，
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to return the log probabilities of the output tokens.

parameters.name: MaxTokens
parameters.description_zh: 用于限制模型输出的最大 Token 数。若生成内容超过此值，生成将提前停止。适用于需控制输出长度的场景。
parameters.description_en: Limits the maximum number of tokens the model can generate. If the output exceeds this value, generation will be truncated. Suitable for scenarios where you need to control the output length.

parameters.name: Messages
parameters.description_zh: 传递给大模型的上下文，按对话顺序排列。
parameters.description_en: The conversation context passed to the model, arranged in chronological order.

parameters.name: ModalitiesList
parameters.description_zh: 输出数据的模态，仅适用于 Qwen-Omni 模型。
parameters.description_en: Output data modality; only applicable to the Qwen-Omni model.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description_zh: 模型名称。支持的模型：Qwen系列的纯文本大语言模型（商业版、开源版）。不支持多模态模型
parameters.description_en: The model name. Supported Models: Qwen series text-only Large Language Models (Commercial and Open-source). Multi-modal models are not supported.

parameters.name: NeedDesensitization
parameters.description_zh: 是否需要进行脱敏，默认为false
parameters.description_en: Whether to enable data masking. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: PresencePenalty
parameters.description_zh: 控制模型生成文本时的内容重复度。取值范围：[-2.0, 2.0]。正值降低重复度，负值增加重复度。
parameters.description_en: Controls the degree of repetition in generated text. Valid values: \[-2.0, 2.0]. Positive values decrease repetition, while negative values increase it.

parameters.name: ResponseFormat
parameters.description_zh: 返回内容的格式。可选值：text：输出文字回复；json_object：输出标准格式的JSON字符串。
parameters.description_en: The format of the returned content. Valid values: text: Plain text response; json_object: Standardized JSON string.

parameters.name: SearchOptions
parameters.description_zh: 联网搜索的策略。
parameters.description_en: Web search strategy.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.description_zh: 随机数种子。用于确保在相同输入和参数下生成结果可复现。取值范围：[0, 2^31−1]。
parameters.description_en: Random seed. Used to ensure the reproducibility of results under the same input and parameters. Valid values: \[0, 2^31−1].

parameters.name: Stop
parameters.description_zh: 停止词列表。
parameters.description_en: Stop sequences.

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.description_zh: 采样温度，控制模型生成文本的多样性。temperature越高，生成的文本更多样，反之，生成的文本更确定。取值范围： [0, 2)
parameters.description_en: The sampling temperature controls the diversity of the generated text. The higher the temperature, the more diverse the generated text, and conversely, the more deterministic the generated text. Valid values: \[0, 2).

parameters.name: ThinkingBudget
parameters.description_zh: 思考过程的最大token数
parameters.description_en: The maximum number of tokens allowed for the model's internal reasoning process.

parameters.name: TopK
parameters.description_zh: 指定生成过程中用于采样的候选 Token 数量。值越大，输出越随机；值越小，输出越确定。若设为null或大于 100，则禁用。
parameters.description_en: Specifies the number of candidate tokens to consider during sampling. Higher values increase randomness, while lower values make the output more deterministic. Set to null or a value greater than 100 to disable.

parameters.name: TopLogprobs
parameters.description_zh: 指定在每一步生成时，返回模型最大概率的候选 Token 个数。取值范围：[0, 5]。
parameters.description_en: Specifies the number of most likely candidate tokens to return at each generation step. Valid values: \[0, 5].

parameters.name: TopP
parameters.description_zh: 核采样的概率阈值，控制模型生成文本的多样性。top_p越高，生成的文本更多样。取值范围：（0,1.0]。
parameters.description_en: The probability threshold for nucleus sampling, used to control the diversity of the generated text. Higher Top-P values result in more diverse generated text. Valid values: (0,1.0].

parameters.name: VlHighResolutionImages
parameters.description_zh: 是否将输入图像的像素上限提升至 16384 Token 对应的像素值。
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to increase the maximum pixel limit of input images to the equivalent of 16,384 tokens.

parameters.name: XDashScopeDataInspection
parameters.description_zh: 在通义千问 API 的内容安全能力基础上，是否进一步识别输入输出内容的违规信息。
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to further identify non-compliant information in both input and output content, building upon the built-in content safety capabilities of the Tongyi Qianwen API.
